<!-- Title, description and "Last updated" on each card are read out of the two
     child pages' front matter, so the nightly sync only has to touch those --

Two documents, kept current automatically — the resume from
[resume_typst](https://github.com/dyavorsky/resume_typst) and the CV from
[cv_typst](https://github.com/dyavorsky/cv_typst). Click either to read it in the
browser or download the PDF.
